output.explanation: Expanded the sole diagram, call-core; none were left unchanged. Nested binding execution, font changes, clipboard completion, resizing and child-exit handling beneath their callers. Pulled IO execution/parsing and rendering into two adjacent peripheral diagrams, connecting worker entry points, mailboxes, shared-state hand-offs and shutdown. Verified against the pinned checkout without changing it. Corrections include: setCellSize queues IO resize rather than calling Surface.resize; DPI changes explicitly force resize; cursor-key actions scroll before writing; search UI alone does not start a worker; drawing and animation scheduling follow updateFrame rather than run inside it; scrollbar publication is deferred even on early drawing returns. Mailbox backpressure can temporarily release the terminal mutex.
